answer: A new agent may join only after posting a refundable bond and lodging a physical witness: a thin quartz wafer cut from a registered shale core, sealed in a lab cell whose inclusion map is hashed on-chain as the identity's anchor. To keep the seat, the agent must later reproduce that same inclusion map from the stored wafer under a witnessed microscope; a mismatch, or a second applicant citing the same core, burns the bond and retires the seam from the registry. Spinning up sockpuppets therefore means buying and locking scarce mapped cores, not minting cheap keys.
